rows.ARS:
Yellow blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: WEKgobafa
Exhibition name: Good as Gold
rows.Origin:
Bred by Tom Carruth (United States, before 2010).
Introduced in United States by Weeks Wholesale Rose Grower, Inc. in 2014 as 'Good as Gold'.
Introduced in United Kingdom by C & K Jones in circa 2018 as 'Golden Delicious'.
rows.Bloom: Orange, golden-yellow shading, red highlights. Flowers deep golden orange-yellow finished with a kiss of red. Mild, tea fragrance. 27 to 35 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, classic hybrid tea bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long, pointed, ovoid buds.
rows.Habit:
Tall, bushy, spreading, upright, well-branched. Large, glossy, dark green foliage. 3 to 7 leaflets.

Height: 47" to 6'7" (120 to 200cm). Width: 5'11" to 6'11" (180 to 210cm).
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden.
